answer_1.quote: ME first retrieves and extracts related information of three modalities... and further automatically generates related sub-questions corresponding to all three modalities. ... Multimodal QA Generator that generates related sub-questions.
answer_1.outputs: Multiple‑choice sub‑questions (visual, textual, background‑knowledge) with four answer choices each

answer_4.quote: We designed and deployed a user interface on Amazon Mechanical Turk platform and hired experienced turkers ... to help verify the correctness of our questions and answers.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers were asked to verify grammar, understandability of the question, and select the correct answer choices; they could also re‑correct or provide their own answer choices.
